name: Components own their state, not EditorApplication
body:
# Components own their state, not EditorApplication

Dean (2026-11-05): with Chaos component children and `@provide`/`@context` merged (chaos-ui-framework #3), update the world editor so behaviour lives with its components and `EditorApplication` doesn't grow a method for each one. `EditorApplication.nyx` holds about 30 signals and 66 methods, many used by one component only.
plan:
Keep in `EditorApplication` what spans components: the revision poll and the model snapshots it refreshes (toolbar, status, history, log, recent files, inspector groups), commands and keys, the document and file dialogs, and the overlays Escape closes (menus, context menu, palette, help, confirm, settings) with the hovered entity the context menu needs.

Move into the component that uses it:

- Outliner: the filter, collapsed rows, the drag state and drop handlers. It builds its rows from the app's revision.
- Inspector: collapsed groups and the new-property name; field edits call the host directly where they don't touch app state.
- ConsolePanel: the level filters; the app keeps the unfiltered log.
- AssetBrowser: the preview template and Add.
- CommandPalette: its query, the matching commands and its keys.
- SettingsDialog and its tabs: the active tab, the snap-step and grid-spacing choices and the view-option, snap, ortho and bookmark calls.
- Toolbar, HistoryPanel: tool, camera preset and history jumps call the host directly.
- Static layout helpers (menu sizes, the controls hint, the shortcuts help) go to the components that show them.
acceptance_criteria: Every panel, dialog and menu behaves as before.
EditorApplication keeps only state shared by more than one component.
definition_of_done: Screenshots of the panels in the chat
editor builds clean against Chaos proto
